name: resurfacing_curate_user
content: Return the JSON array of the ones worth resurfacing. JSON only.

variables.name: candidates
variables.description: Numbered candidate list, one per line as '{index}. {title} — {digest excerpt}'. The index is the stable handle the model must echo back in each selection. Titles + short local digest excerpts only; never a raw body.
examples:
0. Plan the Tokyo trip — flights half-booked, hotel still open
1. Renew passport — expires next quarter

metadata.description: User prompt for the Proactive Resurfacing LLM curator (resurfacing_curate): feeds the numbered candidate digest and asks for the JSON array of chosen items with their surface line + why-now.
metadata.author: magician
metadata.changelog: v1.0.0: Initial resurfacing curator user prompt.
